data.overview: After physician Daniel Brooks is killed shortly after ending a relationship, his close friend Sam Vale begins making a documentary for the son Daniel will never meet. As the child's future draws near, the film becomes an intimate search for truth, memory, and the meaning of family.
data.tagline: A father's story, saved for his son.
data.title: A Letter for Noah
